title: lane r1: governed set undefined; falsifiers key on undefined or self-declared predicate
description: Lane round 1. Lenses: SE (F1) + QE (F6) merged (validators: SO, SE). Owner: SO session. Citations verified: contract:51, :64, :66, :81, :83. Proposed: resolved-candidate — define the governed set decidably (changes altering built behavior: executable source, build/dependency manifests, emitted diagnostics/schemas; behavior-preserving mechanical passes excluded and stated) and key both falsifiers on that one predicate.
